headline: Nigeria Sets November 20 for 2026 Oil and Gas Licensing Round
summary: The Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission will open the bid portal for Nigeria's 2026 oil and gas licensing round on November 20, offering 40 blocks.
why: Licensing rounds dictate future exploration rights, capital expenditure commitments, and long-term production potential for national and international energy companies operating in resource-rich nations.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Opening oil and gas blocks to investment shapes future domestic energy production.
